mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.postno, p.board_type, p.title, substr(p.text, 1, 200) AS text, u.nickname, p.hitcount, l.count_likes, p.created_at FROM posts p JOIN ( SELECT postno, count(userid) AS count_likes FROM post_likes GROUP BY postno ) l ON(p.postno = l.postno) JOIN users u ON(p.writer = u.userid) ORDER BY (p.hitcount + l.count_likes) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
